children.text: My favourite subject is English because it is a very interesting language.
children.cn: 我最喜欢的学科是英语，因为这是一门非常有趣的语言。
children.notes: favourite subject = 最喜爱的学科；interesting language = 有趣的语言
children.statement: “because” 引导原因状语从句，回答了提示中的 (1) 和 (2)。
children.explanation: 明确表达了最喜欢的学科及核心原因。

children.text: It is also very useful in our daily life.
children.cn: 它在我们的日常生活中也很有用。
children.notes: in our daily life = 在我们的日常生活中；useful = 有用的
children.statement: “useful” 进一步补充说明英语的重要性。
children.explanation: useful 体现学科的实用价值。

children.text: I like it a lot and I want to speak English well.
children.cn: 我非常喜欢它，并且我想把英语说好。
children.notes: speak English well = 讲好英语；want to do sth. = 想要做某事
children.explanation: 副词 well 修饰实义动词 speak。
children.keywords: like it a lot, speak English well

children.text: Our English teacher, Mrs. Li, is great and patient.
children.cn: 我们的英语老师李老师非常优秀且有耐心。
children.notes: English teacher = 英语老师；patient = 有耐心的
children.statement: “Mrs. Li” 是主语 our English teacher 的同位语。
children.explanation: 同位语补充说明老师姓名，回答提示 (3)。
children.keywords: English teacher, Mrs. Li, great, patient

children.text: All the students in our class like her and her lessons.
children.cn: 我们班所有的同学都喜欢她和她的课。
children.notes: in our class = 在我们班；lessons = 课程
children.statement: 本句描述了老师在班级里受学生欢迎的程度。
children.explanation: 体现了良好的师生关系。
children.keywords: students, in our class, like lessons

children.text: Her classes are always easy, lively and interesting.
children.cn: 她的课总是通俗易懂、生动有趣。
children.notes: lively = 生动的；interesting = 有趣的
children.statement: 句中使用了三个并列形容词作表语。
children.explanation: easy, lively and interesting 共同描述课堂氛围。

children.text: I like talking with her in English after class.
children.cn: 下课后我喜欢用英语和她交谈。
children.notes: talk with sb. in English = 用英语和某人交谈；after class = 下课后
children.explanation: 介词 in + 语言 表示使用某种语言进行交流。
children.keywords: talking with her, in English, after class

children.text: English brings me so much joy and confidence.
children.cn: 英语带给我如此多的快乐与自信。
children.notes: bring sb. sth. = 带给某人某物；confidence = 自信
children.statement: 文末总结升华对英语学科的热爱。
children.explanation: 提升了习作的情感与思想高度。

children.text: Among all the junior high subjects, English is definitely my favourite.
children.cn: 在所有初中学科中，英语绝对是我的最爱。
children.notes: junior high subjects = 初中学科；definitely = 明确地，绝对地
children.statement: “definitely” 副词在句中起强调修饰作用。
children.explanation: 精准表达对英语情有独钟的态度。
children.keywords: junior high subjects, English, definitely favourite

children.text: Not only is it a globally used language, but it also opens a magical window to diverse world cultures.
children.cn: 它不仅是一门全球通用的语言，而且还为我们打开了一扇通往多元世界文化的奇妙窗口。
children.notes: Not only... but also... 部分倒装句；diverse world cultures = 多元的世界文化
children.statement: “Not only is it...” 为部分倒装结构。
children.explanation: 倒装句型展现高阶语法功底。
children.keywords: globally used language, magical window, diverse cultures

children.text: Learning English allows me to appreciate classic stories and communicate smoothly with foreign friends.
children.cn: 学习英语使我能够欣赏经典故事，并能与外国朋友顺畅交流。
children.notes: allow sb. to do sth. = 允许/使某人做某事；communicate smoothly = 顺畅交流
children.statement: 动名词短语 “Learning English” 作主语。
children.explanation: 动名词作主语时，谓语动词用第三人称单数 allows。
children.keywords: appreciate stories, communicate smoothly, foreign friends

children.text: Our English teacher, Mrs. Li, is an enthusiastic educator whom we all deeply admire.
children.cn: 我们的英语老师李老师是一位充满热情的教育工作者，我们大家都深深地钦佩她。
children.notes: enthusiastic educator = 充满热情的教育者；whom 引导定语从句
children.statement: “whom” 引导定语从句，并在从句中作 admire 的宾语。
children.explanation: 定语从句精准体现全班学生对老师的敬佩之情。

children.text: She always designs fascinating interactive games and role-play activities to make grammar easy to master.
children.cn: 她总是设计引人入胜的互动游戏和角色扮演活动，让语法变得容易掌握。
children.notes: interactive games = 互动游戏；role-play = 角色扮演；easy to master = 容易掌握
children.statement: “to make grammar easy to master” 动词不定式作目的状语。
children.explanation: 不定式作状语清晰表达设计活动的目的。
children.keywords: interactive games, role-play activities, easy to master

children.text: Whenever I encounter tricky sentences, she patiently guides me until I completely understand.
children.cn: 每当我遇到棘手的句子时，她总是耐心地引导我，直到我完全理解。
children.notes: Whenever = 每当；encounter tricky sentences = 遇到棘手的句子；until = 直到
children.explanation: whenever 让步时间状语从句体现日常耐心辅导细节。
children.keywords: Whenever, encounter tricky sentences, patiently guides

children.text: Thanks to her encouraging words, I have become much more confident and eager to explore the language further.
children.cn: 多亏了她鼓励的话语，我变得更加自信，并渴望进一步探索这门语言。
children.notes: Thanks to = 多亏，幸亏；eager to do sth. = 渴望做某事
children.statement: “Thanks to” 为介词短语，表示感谢与原因。
children.explanation: 文末总结提升，语言优美流畅。
children.keywords: Thanks to, encouraging words, confident, explore language
